data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2017 and prior) increased by $64.2m ($29.5m net of RI). Of this, $58.3m ($26.9m net of RI) relates to Casualty division losses on 2016 and prior underwriting years of account. The remainder is driven by newly occurring large losses, mostly from multi-year construction policies in the Tech division. At the same time claim experience during 2019 on the Aviation and Marine divisions on 2017 and prior underwriting years has been within expectations.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross adverse prior-year development of $64.2m in 2019 (approximately 9.1% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven predominantly by $58.3m of adverse development in the Casualty division relating to 2016 and earlier years and the balance from newly occurring large losses, chiefly multi-year construction losses in the Technical (property/construction) area. The movement is reported gross of reinsurance and materially deteriorated the prior-year reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year development (gross $64.2m) comes from explicit narrative on claims movement (gross). Casualty and construction/Technical allocations are from the same narrative (exact split provided). Triangles and RDS tables are present and have been transcribed; triangle values are reported in thousands (as printed). Mapping of 'Tech division' construction losses to 'Property' LOB is an interpretative mapping and may have some residual uncertainty.
